column1: # EDA calibration coefficients — shifted Michaelis-Menten model (fit on raw samples)
# Inverse : G   = G0 + K * Raw / (Rmax - Raw)
# G0_std / K_std  : curve_fit covariance on all raw samples
# sigma_raw       : mean ADC noise floor across resistance conditions [ADC]
# G_min / G_max   : conductance at RAW thresholds [µS]
# NOTE: *_min/mid/max refer to position on G axis
#       S is highest at G_min (steep); resolution is best at G_min (low res_min value)
